## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they fail when the behaviour is removed
- [ ] `npm run check` passes in `backend/` (or frontend CI is green)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real personal data in code, tests, fixtures, logs or screenshots
- [ ] New inputs are validated with a strict schema; new errors are generic (no stack, query or user values)
- [ ] New personal data is justified, has a retention rule, and is covered by the privacy notice
- [ ] Docs or ADR updated if a decision changed
- [ ] If this adds a dependency: reason, maintainer and licence checked, lockfile updated
